resources.string: Off by default. Sends displayed chat text to TypeSafe Jev and shows analysis below the matching bubble; requires an API key.

Save your key and settings here, then enable the switch. Entering a chat analyzes the latest messages; render mode also analyzes messages as they appear. New database messages refresh recent older results within the configured range. Each request sends TypeSafe up to the configured number of preceding messages from both sides, quoted content, all relevant later messages within the refresh window, and your chat background and notes. Group members remain distinct; images and stickers are sent as placeholders. Results stay in memory only. Tap a bubble label for details. More context or refreshes increase requests and cost. Settings stay local.
Analyze text messages as they appear while scrolling

My messages: recent chat positions to refresh (also sets later context window, 0–200)
